en.title: Second Marriage and Polygamy: What Does the Law Require?
en.directAnswer: During an existing Muslim marriage, section 6 of the Muslim Family Laws Ordinance requires previous written permission from the Arbitration Council before another marriage is contracted. The law sets a formal application process. Do not reduce this to the simple statement that “the first wife must give permission.”

atAGlance.whoFor: A Muslim man or spouse wants to understand the legal permission process.
atAGlance.mainRule: During an existing Muslim marriage, section 6 of the Muslim Family Laws Ordinance requires previous written permission f
atAGlance.updateStatus: Use the current section 6 text. Avoid moral or religious commentary; explain only the legal process.

en.lawMeaning:
The statutory decision is made through the Arbitration Council process. Existing wife or wives are part of that process, but the legal test should be described from the actual section.

This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Confirm an existing marriage is still legally in force.
Apply to the Chairman in the required form.
State the reasons for the proposed marriage.
Obtain written permission before contracting the later marriage.
evidence: Relevant official notices, receipts, and correspondence
en.simpleExample: A man says his first wife agreed by text message, so no other step is needed. That is unsafe. The law requires the formal Arbitration Council permission process.
commonMistakes: Treating private consent as a substitute for statutory permission.
en.specialistTrigger: Existing second marriage without permission; disputed marriage status; dower consequences; foreign marriage.
